title: Hygiene & Safety
welcome_lead: Wash hands, separate raw, cook properly — stay safe.
meta_desc: KS3 D&T food: food hygiene and safety rules.

concepts.def: Bacteria moving raw to cooked food.
Tiny germs that can cause illness.
Date food quality drops, still safe.

walkthroughs.body_html: Always wash hands with soap for 20 seconds before cooking, after touching raw meat, after the toilet. Tie back hair, wear an apron, no jewellery.
Cross-contamination happens when bacteria from raw meat reach ready-to-eat food. Use separate chopping boards (red for raw meat, green for veg) and wash hands between.
Bacteria multiply fast between 5°C and 63°C — the danger zone. Keep cold food in the fridge (under 5), hot food piping hot (above 63), and never leave cooked food out.
